answer: Proposal 'chaingate': each seat must publish, every epoch, a verifiable delay proof chained to its prior output — one strictly sequential computation per key, a trellis no parallelism can shortcut (assume the delay function is genuinely non-parallelizable). Splitting gains nothing: N keys need N dedicated cores running all epoch, since the schedule is rigid as a sonnet's form. Cost is linear in rented cores, deterring only while per-seat epoch reward stays below one core's rental. Missed links are slashed; rare re-verification returns like a comet.
